items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And, and, and he got up out of bed and we stole out. And Mama went to the market. And, and we stole out and we made all around. He took me, you know, he used to like race horses.

ctx.x: And she was just a year old. And when he comes back home, she didn't recognize him right away. And that just, he said, I'm never in the ball. I was his aunt. He was, he was dying almost. And, and, and he got up by the way. And he was, and he was dying almost.

And, and, and he got up out of bed and we stole out. And Mama went to the market. And, and we stole out and we made all around. He took me, you know, he used to like race horses. And he took me by Pratt's and by the people who had his diamonds. Farron Tellers.
